title: You Live in the Past (And Never Notice) ⏳
caption:
Everything you see already happened.

Sunlight is 8 minutes old, your brain waits ~80 milliseconds before writing the story, edits out every eye jump and fills in your blind spot.

Which level broke your brain? 👇

#brain #neuroscience #science #stickman #reelsinstagram
